values: Maintainable test register for demo and practical assessment. Update the Pass/Fail, Comments, Tested By, Test Date, Defect ID and Evidence columns on the Test Cases sheet.

1. Execute each case using the stated steps.
2. Select Pass or Fail only after checking the expected result.
3. Record tester name and date for traceability.
4. For failures, add the defect ID, evidence reference and a clear comment.
5. Filter by module, requirement type, test type, result or tester during reviews.
6. Re-test failed cases after fixes and update the row with the latest outcome.
Use the filters to review test coverage. Yellow columns are maintained by testers. Pass/Fail is intentionally blank until each test is executed.
Requirement types: Functional tests verify features and workflows. Non-functional tests verify security, performance, usability, reliability, accessibility and compatibility.
Start the API and web application with the configured SQL Server database.
Open the public site, staff login, and API health endpoint.
All surfaces load without startup errors; health reports healthy; no secrets appear in messages.
Start against a new empty test database.
Apply migrations and run the application bootstrap.
Schema, roles, defaults, and configured administrator are created once without duplicate seed data.
Run the main workflow in current Chrome or Edge.
Log in; open dashboard, register, bookings, and reports.
Pages render and controls work without browser-specific failure.
Check desktop, tablet, and phone widths.
Resize each main page; open dialogs, menus, and tables.
No blocked controls, clipped dialogs, unintended horizontal page jump, or unreadable content.
Open a permitted module directly, refresh, then use Back and Forward.
The route remains valid, session is restored, and browser navigation shows the correct module.
Open a data page and retry after the API returns.
A clear non-technical error appears; input is not silently lost; retry succeeds without duplicate writes.
Verify Fiji date/time display around midnight and date filters.
Create a timestamped record and filter it for the same Fiji calendar date.
Stored UTC time is displayed and filtered using the correct Fiji date.
Review demo data and visible configuration.
Search customers, agreements, emails, and settings for real credentials or personal data.
Only approved fictional test data is present; credentials and connection strings are not exposed.
Sign in with a valid active staff account.
Enter correct email and password and submit.
The correct role, division, and branch session opens and a login audit event is recorded.
Attempt staff login with an incorrect password.
Submit valid email with wrong password.
Login is rejected with a generic message and no account details are disclosed.
Access is denied but comment shows username or email is incorrect, should it show any other message apart from that.
Attempt login using an inactive or locked staff account.
Access is denied and the event is available to authorized administrators.
Complete login for an account requiring MFA.
Enter credentials, then the valid verification code.
No staff data is available before verification; successful verification creates the session.
Use an invalid MFA code, then request a resend.
Submit invalid code; resend; submit the replacement valid code.
Invalid code is rejected; resend is rate-safe; the latest valid code completes sign-in.
Sign in with a temporary password.
Attempt navigation, then set a compliant new password.
Only the change-password page is available until success; normal access resumes afterward.
Try weak, mismatched, and reused password values.
Submit each invalid combination, then a compliant password.
Invalid values show specific validation without changing the password; compliant value succeeds.
Request and complete a staff password reset.
Request for a known account, use the token once, then try to reuse it.
Response does not disclose account existence; valid token resets once; reuse/expired token fails.
Reuse the authenticated cookie in a second browser window identity.
Copy/open session in another window, then sign in there.
Shared cookie is rejected; a new login transfers the active session to the new window.
Leave an authenticated session idle for the configured period.
Wait beyond the idle limit, then perform an action.
The request is rejected and the UI returns to login without exposing protected data.
Keep activity going beyond the absolute session duration.
Perform periodic safe reads, then act after the absolute limit.
The session expires even though it was active and requires a new login.
Log out and test the previous session.
Log out, use Back, and retry a protected URL/API call.
Protected data is not shown and the revoked session cannot be reused.
Send repeated login or API requests rapidly.
Exceed the configured request rate in a test environment.
Excess requests are limited predictably; the service remains available afterward.
Verify module visibility for every staff role.
Sign in as Super Administrator, Administrator, Branch Manager, Rental Officer, and Maintenance Officer.
Each role sees only the modules defined for it; hidden modules cannot be opened by direct URL.
Try to read a record from another branch as branch-scoped staff.
Open or alter the URL/API identifier for another branch record.
The request is forbidden or not found and no cross-branch data is disclosed.
Try to access another division as division-scoped staff.
Use asset, maintenance, or operation identifiers from another division.
No read or write succeeds outside the assigned division.
Search and open records from multiple active divisions and branches.
Authorized group-wide records are available with their division and branch clearly identified.

Compare a Super Administrator with branch staff granted branch/category configuration and staff without those permissions. Test assigned and unrelated branches/divisions; attempt global settings as lower roles.
Global system settings require system-administration access. Granted branch/category actions work only within assigned scope; unrelated writes are rejected.
Remove one granular permission from a role/user.
Refresh session and attempt the affected action.
The control is unavailable or disabled and the API independently rejects the action.
Assign and remove user branch/division scopes.
Save valid scopes, refresh, then remove a scope.
Access changes match saved scope and take effect without granting stale access.
Try assigning group-wide scope as a non-Super Administrator.
Submit the scope through UI or API.
The request is rejected and current scopes remain unchanged.
Change a user's role, scope, or permission.
Save the change and inspect audit history.
Who changed what and when is recorded without exposing secrets.
Open the dashboard for each staff role.
Compare cards, queues, shortcuts, and totals with permitted data.
Content is role-appropriate, branch scoped, and links open the expected filtered work area.
Validate dashboard counts against source registers.
Count representative assets, bookings, maintenance work, and tasks in source modules.
Dashboard figures agree with the same active filters and access scope.
Search by asset code, customer, booking, and reference.
Enter full and partial terms and open each result.
Relevant permitted records appear; selection opens the correct module/record.
Search for known records outside the user's branch.
Use exact identifiers as branch-scoped staff.
Unauthorized results are not returned or inferable.
Receive and read a staff notification.
Trigger an approval/task event, open the bell, and mark it read.
Unread count updates, message links correctly, and read state persists.
Save multiple notification preference values and clear them.
Toggle channels/events, save, reload, and reset.
Distinct values persist accurately and can be cleared without affecting unrelated settings.
Select role/user target, enter message, and send.
Only eligible recipients receive one notification and an email record follows configuration.
Reconnect notification polling around a new event.
Disconnect/reconnect while an event is created.
The event is not missed and is not duplicated in the recipient list.
Create a test division through guided setup.

As Super Administrator, open Organization & settings > Business setup > Divisions & services. Add business / division with a unique code/name; complete required service, category and branch setup; save and reopen.
The division and selected related records persist once. Reopening shows the saved configuration.
Reject missing and duplicate division identity.
Attempt setup with a blank required name/code, then an existing division code. Save each attempt and refresh the division list.
Each invalid save is rejected with a useful message; no duplicate or partial division is created.
Create and edit a division service.
In Divisions & services, select Add service. Enter valid service details and online visibility; save. Edit its name, save and reload.
Service remains linked to its division; changed details persist without duplicate records.
Create a branch with eligible services.
Open Business setup > Branches. Add a unique test branch, select its division memberships and eligible services; save and reload.
Branch, memberships and selected services persist. Services from unrelated divisions cannot be assigned.
Verify branch status persistence and scope.
Using a test branch, deactivate and reactivate it in Branches; reload after each save. Check historical records and try the action as staff scoped to another branch.
Status persists and history remains. Out-of-scope changes are rejected without changing status.
Save operating hours and a dated closure.
Open Branch operations and select a test branch. Set weekday hours and add a closure. Save branch configuration, reload, then try a pickup on the closed date.
Hours and closure persist; pickup validation applies the saved calendar and explains rejected dates.
Disable and re-enable a branch service.
In Branch operations, clear an enabled service and save. Reload, enable the same service, save and reload again.
The saved enabled state is restored without duplicate service mappings; unrelated services are unchanged.
Verify eligible services follow division membership.
In Branches, assign a test branch to a division and save. Open its Branch operations and review Services at this location.
Only services belonging to assigned divisions are offered. Saved memberships persist after reload.
Configure a test fee and verify persistence.
Open Booking & pricing > Fees & charges. Add a uniquely named fee with basis, amount and tax flag; save and reopen. Edit the amount and inspect an existing saved charge.
Definition changes persist for subsequent use; existing saved transaction amounts remain unchanged.
Verify a configured approval rule against requests.
Open Booking & pricing > Approval rules. Create a test rule with a specific request type, conditions and ordered stages. Save; submit one matching and one nonmatching request.
The matching request follows saved approval stages; the nonmatching request is not routed by that rule.
Check the delegation requirement before execution.
Inspect Approval rules for delegation controls. No delegation UI was located in the reviewed build. If absent, record this capability gap; do not substitute ordinary approval rules.
Requirement remains unmet until bounded delegate assignment is available and enforces user/date limits. Do not record Pass for ordinary approvals.
Save and reuse a notification template.

Open Communications > Notifications. Record a test template, edit subject/message, Save template and reload. Trigger its event in a test environment; inspect the generated notification, then restore the template.
Saved wording persists and is used by a newly generated matching notification. External delivery depends on the configured provider.
Create a staff account with role and scope.
Enter valid unique details and temporary password.
User is created once, receives the intended role/scope, and must change password if configured.
Try creating a staff account with an existing email.
Creation is rejected without duplicate identity or partial scope records.
Change name, role, scope, and active status.
Save each change and re-authenticate as the user.
New identity/access values apply and unrelated fields remain unchanged.
Try to demote/disable self or the final active Super Administrator.
The system blocks lockout-causing changes and explains the reason.
Issue reset; sign in with old then temporary password.
Old password fails, temporary password works, and forced change is enforced.
Confirm locked state, perform unlock, and sign in.
Lockout clears without altering role/scope and an audit entry is recorded.
Revoke all sessions for another staff user.
Keep that user logged in, revoke, then perform an action.
Existing sessions terminate and a fresh login is required.
Use the departure action and review assignments, access, and sessions.
Account is disabled, sessions revoked, and affected responsibilities are visible for reassignment.
Review registered customer accounts awaiting verification.
Filter/open account and verify profile, documents, and status.
Queue data is accurate and only authorized administrators can manage access.
Reset password, revoke sessions, block, and reactivate a customer account.
Perform each action and test the customer session.
Each action has the expected immediate effect and is audited.
Review system health and email delivery queue.
Open health, inspect failures, and retry an eligible failed email.
Status is current; retry creates a controlled new attempt without duplicate business action.
After an authorized setting change, open the available health/audit view and locate the recent action. Inspect actor, time and summary. Do not assume date filters or page two exist in this view.
The relevant event is readable and accurate; audit entries are not editable. Missing filters are recorded separately rather than tested as existing controls.
Create an individual customer with required contacts.
A unique customer record is created and searchable.
Verify the corporate-customer requirement and current gap.

Open Customers > Add customer. Check for corporate identity, separate primary contacts and billing fields. These controls are absent in the reviewed form; retain failure evidence and retest after implementation.
A corporate record must retain company identity, contacts and billing details for bookings/finance. A company name in Full name alone does not satisfy this case.
Submit blank required fields, invalid email/phone, and duplicate identity.
Clear field errors appear and no partial customer is created.
Change permitted values, save, and reload.
New values persist and related historical documents retain their original snapshot values where applicable.
Block, deactivate, restore, and activate a customer.
Attempt a new booking/login at each status.
Blocked/inactive states prevent prohibited activity while history remains visible.
Search/filter by name, account type, email, and status.
Use exact, partial, and no-match terms.
Correct scoped records appear and clearing filters restores the list.
Enable online access for an existing customer.
Create access, complete verification, and log in.
The identity links to the correct customer without creating a duplicate profile.
Upload a readable supported driver licence image.
Run OCR, review extracted fields, correct if needed, and confirm.
Image and confirmed licence fields are securely attached to the intended customer.
Upload unreadable, oversized, or unsupported licence content.
The system rejects unsafe/invalid input with a recoverable message and no false verification.
Enter number, class, issue/expiry dates, and verification status.
Dates and fields validate; saved licence appears in readiness checks.
Use an expired or soon-expiring licence for a vehicle rental.
The system warns or blocks according to configured verification rules.
Try viewing/downloading another branch customer's licence.
Use a direct document URL/API request.
Access is denied; sensitive image data is not leaked.
Compare bookings, payments, requests, and security events with source records.
Chronology and references are accurate and scoped.
Browse active public divisions, branches, and assets anonymously.
Open landing page and change division/branch/category filters.
Only public, active, operational offerings appear with correct photos and summary data.
Search assets by name/code/category and clear filters.
Use partial, mixed-case, and no-match terms.
Results update correctly and an understandable empty state appears.
Search with valid dates and an available asset.
Choose branch, start, and end dates.
Only nonconflicting assets remain and displayed rates/availability match staff planning.
Use equal, reversed, past, or unsupported duration dates.
Request is rejected before persistence with a clear validation message.
Request a private division or nonoperational asset directly.
The asset is excluded or unavailable without revealing restricted details.
Review gallery, specifications, rate information, deposit, and availability.
Content belongs to the selected asset and broken/missing images have a safe fallback.
Register a new customer with valid data.
Submit profile and strong password, then activate/verify.
One customer identity/profile is created and the customer session opens as designed.
Try duplicate email, weak password, malformed fields, and mismatched passwords.
No identity/customer/cookie is created and field-level errors are shown.
Sign in and sign out through the customer portal.
Use correct credentials, navigate, sign out, and use Back.
Own portal data is shown; sign-out removes access to protected pages.
Submit an authenticated request for an available asset/service.
Choose dates/options, review quote, and confirm.
A reference is created atomically with correct customer, pricing, branch, and pending hold.
Submit competing requests for the same asset/time.
Create one pending request, then a conflicting request; repeat after hold expiry.
Active hold prevents overlap; expiry releases availability without duplicate records.
Submit a service configured as quotation only.
A complete quotation request is created, not a confirmed booking; failure leaves no partial request.
Look up a valid and invalid public reference.
Valid progress appears without private data; invalid reference reveals nothing sensitive.
Attempt to open another customer's booking, agreement, or document.
Access is denied and no other-customer data is returned.
Change dates for an eligible draft booking.
Save valid new dates, then try invalid/conflicting dates.
Eligible change succeeds; invalid change is rejected without mutation; confirmed change routes to review.
Submit cancellation, extension, and incident requests.
Create each request once and attempt duplicates.
Staff queue receives one traceable case per valid request; invalid/duplicate requests are controlled.
Accept and reject an eligible customer quote.
Perform each decision on separate quotes and retry.
Status changes once, staff is notified, and an invalid repeat transition is rejected.
Upload, list, download, and validate customer documents.
Use valid file then unsafe extension/oversize file.
Valid document is private and downloadable; unsafe input is rejected; metadata is accurate.
Save multiple values, reload, and clear optional values.
Changes persist only for the signed-in customer and are used for later communication.
Create an asset category with attributes and defaults.
Enter unique name/code, type, deposit/service defaults, and save.
Category and dynamic attributes are available for new assets.
Try duplicate keys, invalid data types, and missing required definitions.
Validation prevents an inconsistent schema and preserves the previous definition.
Create a vehicle and an equipment asset.
Enter identity, branch/division, category, rates, meters, and attributes.
Each asset receives a unique record and correct type-specific fields.
Try duplicate asset code, registration, or serial number where unique.
Creation/update is rejected without altering existing assets.
Edit identity, operational details, and dynamic attributes.
Save, reload, and inspect audit history.
Values persist, required fields validate, and change is audited.
Filter by search, division, branch, category, status, and availability.
Results, count, and report scope match filters without skipped/duplicate rows.
Move asset through allowed operational statuses.
Apply valid transition, then an invalid/unsafe transition.
Valid transition updates once; invalid transition is blocked with reason.
Use valid images and unsupported/oversized files; set/review primary display.
Valid images render in staff/public views; invalid files fail safely; deletion affects only target photo.
Record odometer/engine-hour reading and fuel level.
Enter increasing reading, then lower/negative/extreme value.
Valid reading is timestamped and attributed; invalid decrease/value is rejected or explicitly controlled.
Fill required section checks, notes, photos, and outcome.
Required checks are enforced; result and evidence appear in profile/history.
Fail a required check and save.
Asset becomes unavailable as required and traceable maintenance work/routing is created.
Generate and print an asset QR label.
Open label for an asset and scan the printed/on-screen code.
Code resolves uniquely to the same asset without embedding sensitive data.
Scan malformed, unknown, or another-scope QR content.
A safe not-found/forbidden response appears and no wrong asset is opened.
Transfer an asset between eligible branches/divisions.
Create, approve/progress, and complete the transfer.
Status/location history update at the correct stage and conflicting hire/activity is blocked.
Retire an eligible asset with reason.
Retire, then try new booking/maintenance scheduling.
Asset remains in history/reports but is excluded from new operational use.
Review identity, specs, availability, hire, inspections, damage, maintenance, meters, transfers, lifecycle, documents, and audit.
Each section is accurate, linked, scoped, and handles empty history professionally.
Compare profile as financial and nonfinancial users.
Open the same asset under each role.
Costs/performance appear only when authorized; hidden data is also blocked at API level.
Generate a detailed report for one asset.
Open report, search/date filter, preview, export PDF/CSV, and compare profile data.
Report includes necessary asset details and permitted financials, labels lifetime figures, and excludes photos/signatures while keeping them in profile.
Open planning calendar for a branch/date range.
Change branch, division, date, and asset filters.
Bookings, holds, maintenance, transfers, and closures appear on correct assets/dates.
Create overlapping booking dates for the same asset.
Save first confirmed booking, then attempt an overlap.
Conflict is blocked atomically and the original booking remains unchanged.
Book an asset during active maintenance/out-of-service state.
Asset is unavailable and the reason is visible to authorized staff.
Book across a configured closure/nonoperating period.
Validation follows configured branch calendar and does not silently ignore closure.
Choose duration and compare base, extras, tax, deposit, and total.
Calculation follows configured rate and rounding.
Price daily and unit-based assets at boundary durations/quantities.
Charged units and totals match the documented rule.
Price the same asset/customer at eligible locations.
Correct precedence is applied and source is understandable to staff.
Apply valid discount and configured extras.
Add/remove extras and test excessive/negative discount.
Valid totals recalculate; prohibited values are rejected; audit/snapshot is retained.
Calculate tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive quotes using current Fiji VAT setting.
Run both modes and compare subtotal, tax, and total.
Tax is not double-counted, rounding is consistent, and saved historical totals remain stable.
Price delivery zone, kilometres, operator hours, and service charges.
Applicable charges use configured rates and invalid input is rejected.
Modify an input and attempt submission without reviewing recalculation.
Price refreshes or stale confirmation is blocked so saved totals match reviewed inputs.
Open and filter booking/quotation work queue.
Filter by branch, status, dates, customer, and reference.
Only scoped matching work appears with actionable status and stable pagination.
Open a booking and verify complete context.
Compare customer, asset, dates, pricing, charges, bond, requests, readiness, and history.
Workspace matches source records and shows only actions valid for current state.
Change dates, asset/options, and notes, then save.
Availability and price are revalidated; valid edits persist and are audited.
Attempt unsupported status changes or skip required stages.
Use UI and direct API request.
Transition is rejected and status/history remain unchanged.
Complete required customer/licence/payment/approval information and confirm.
Booking becomes confirmed, inventory is reserved, and notifications are generated.
Cancel an eligible booking with reason.
Cancel and inspect availability, finance, and customer portal.
Status, reason, released availability, fees/refunds, and communications remain consistent.
Add, edit, and remove booking charges.
Totals recalculate correctly; invalid values fail; historical invoiced values are protected.
Set a permitted custom bond or waiver.
Enter reason and value, save, and review agreement/finance.
Override is authorized, audited, and shown consistently without changing category default.
Generate a quotation from a booking/request.
Review line items, tax, validity, and save.
Numbered quote snapshot is complete and totals match pricing.
Create a quote revision after changing terms.
Revise lines/validity and compare prior version.
New revision is versioned; prior sent content remains traceable.
Send an eligible quote to the customer.
Use send action and inspect status/email record/customer portal.
Status and delivery record synchronize; direct status bypass is rejected.
Accept, reject with reason, expire, and convert valid quotes.
Exercise each on separate records and attempt invalid repeats.
Only legal transitions occur; rejection reason is required; conversion does not duplicate booking.
Create requests that match and do not match configured approval rules.
Test asset type and exact 24-hour duration boundaries.
Correct rule/stage/reason is selected with scope precedence and no unnecessary approval.
Approve and reject at each assigned stage.
Act as assigned and unassigned roles/users.
Authorized decision advances/completes once; unauthorized decision is forbidden; history records comments.
Approve/reject portal cancellation or extension request.
Open case, decide with note, and inspect booking/portal.
Decision updates all linked state and sends one clear customer notification.
Edit the same booking in two sessions.
Save session A, then save stale session B.
Stale update is rejected or reconciled without overwriting the newer record.
Check customer/licence, approval, agreement, payment/bond, asset, inspection, and conflicts.
Each blocker is explicit; handover cannot proceed while a required item is incomplete.
Add an authorized driver to a rental.
Enter valid verified licence details, then invalid/expired details.
Valid driver is attached; invalid driver blocks readiness without corrupting the booking.
Evidence is attached to the correct booking/asset and required entries are enforced.
Scan an asset different from the booking.
Checkout is blocked and the mismatch is clearly identified.
Generate the rental agreement for a confirmed ready booking.
Open preview/PDF and compare customer, asset, dates, rates, charges, bond, terms, and drivers.
Agreement is readable, correctly numbered/versioned, and matches the reviewed booking snapshot.
Sign, clear/redraw before save, then save and reopen.
Required signatures persist with signer/time and cannot be silently replaced after finalization.
Send once, retry after a simulated failure, and inspect delivery record.
Correct version goes to intended recipient; retry is traceable and does not create a new agreement.
Record pickup payment and verify bond.
Use valid payment, then zero/negative/duplicate reference.
Valid payment is recorded once; invalid/duplicate entry is rejected; readiness updates.
Complete handover after all readiness items.
Submit handover and inspect booking/asset/customer portal.
Rental becomes active, asset becomes hired/unavailable, timestamps and responsible staff are recorded.
Submit handover twice or from two sessions.
Second action is idempotently rejected and no duplicate lifecycle/payment/inspection is created.
Record an incident during active hire.
Enter category, description, date, and evidence.
Incident is linked to rental/asset, notifies staff as configured, and is visible in history.
Addendum is versioned, linked to original agreement, and updates applicable dates/charges.
Preview late, excess usage, fuel, cleaning, and damage charges.
Set return readings/condition to trigger each charge.
Proposed charges follow configured definitions and show evidence/basis before confirmation.
Scan asset; record meter/fuel/accessories/checklist/photos/signatures and compare pre-hire.
Differences are clear, required evidence persists, and the correct asset/booking is used.
Fail damage check, confirm return, and inspect maintenance.
Damage is traceable from inspection to a maintenance record; asset does not become available prematurely.
Deduct valid return charges and refund remaining bond.
Apply partial deduction, then try deduction beyond held bond.
Valid allocation/remainder is correct and auditable; excessive deduction is blocked.
Submit final readings, charges, signatures, and payment settlement.
Booking completes, invoice/receipt is available, asset status is correct, and availability is released.
Try return or safety release while booking state is inconsistent.
Use missing handover, wrong status, or open allocation.
Action is blocked with a precise resolution path.
Open workspace with more than twelve active jobs.
All relevant entries are accessible without a trapped inner scrollbar; filters are accurate.
Create corrective and preventive jobs for eligible assets.
Enter issue, priority, dates, technician/supplier, estimate, and source.
Job is uniquely created, asset becomes appropriately unavailable, and source is traceable.
Try a duplicate automatic/open job for the same due condition.
Trigger rule twice or create same work manually.
Duplicate work is prevented or clearly linked rather than silently duplicated.
Read/update another branch or division job.
Use direct identifiers as restricted staff.
Read and write are forbidden and no financial/evidence data leaks.
Create/edit/clear technician with qualifications and locations.
Save multiple exact branch/division pairs and test assignment.
Only qualified/available eligible technicians appear; duplicates/invalid references are rejected.
Enter unique valid data, then duplicate/missing values.
Valid supplier persists; invalid record is rejected without mutation.
Move job through start, wait, resume, complete, cancel, and reopen.
Provide required reasons/notes at each state.
Only legal transitions occur; timestamps, assignee, reasons, and history are accurate.
Attempt completion without summary or current meter.
Submit missing fields, then complete them.
Incomplete save is blocked; valid completion moves asset to Inspection, not directly Available.
Complete preventive maintenance with schedule rules.
Test monthly rule, explicit next date, and next meter target.
Explicit targets take precedence; otherwise recurrence calculates correctly and remains visible.
Test below, equal, and above date/meter threshold.
Set target and readings/dates around boundary.
Below is not due, equal is due now, above is overdue; counts and filters agree.
Visible warning appears and no unsafe automatic job is created.
Open source and safety inspection records from a job.
Review author, notes, meter, checks, and permitted evidence.
Record belongs to same scoped asset; signatures/raw evidence remain protected as designed.
Issue stock to a maintenance job.
Stock decreases once, original unit valuation is retained, and cost appears on the job.
Issue unavailable, zero, excessive, wrong-location, or stale stock quantity.
No negative stock or partial ledger mutation occurs; user can refresh and retry.
Return unused issued stock with reason.
Return part/all quantity and attempt over-return.
Allowed quantity restores stock at original valuation; over-return is rejected and audited.
Record labour, fuel, contractor, parts, and invoice evidence.
Save each cost and compare totals.
Net, tax, and total follow mode; issued stock/internal labour exclusions are correct; evidence is linked.
Test exclusive, inclusive, exempt, and invoice-total modes.
Use same base values and a manual override with/without reason.
Server totals and rounding are correct; override requires reason; tax is not added twice.
Open same job with and without maintenance financial access.
Compare fields/API response and try direct update.
Unauthorized cost/evidence is omitted and cannot be changed; saved values remain intact.
Compare active, cancelled, and completed actual costs with estimates.
Actual totals include recorded actuals, exclude estimates, and keep completed cost distinct.
Pass an authorized safety inspection and release the asset.
Resolve work, complete required checks, use current meter, and release.
Inspector/time is recorded and asset becomes Available only after all blockers clear.
Attempt release with open repair, active hire/allocation, transfer, failed check, due service, or decreasing meter.
Release is denied with the correct blocker and no asset status change.
Save first version then stale second version.
Stale save is rejected; current data and entered draft are recoverable for review.
Use valid file and unsafe/oversized file; test unauthorized branch.
Valid evidence is private and linked; invalid/unauthorized access is blocked.
Open group or branch operations overview.
Compare counts, urgent items, and filters with underlying records.
KPIs and queues reflect access scope and link to matching work.
Create, assign, complete, and filter an operational task.
Task lifecycle, overdue state, ownership, and audit are accurate; duplicate completion is controlled.
Create and progress a customer case.
Link customer/booking, change status, add resolution.
Case remains linked and only valid status transitions are allowed.
Schedule conflicts are visible; milestones and responsible staff are recorded.
Create and progress an operations transfer.
Use valid source/destination and complete each stage.
Asset status/location update at intended stage; invalid/conflicting transfer is rejected.
Unique account links to customer and is available in permitted quote/booking flows.
Set validity dates and attempt assignment before/after expiry.
Only appropriately qualified current personnel can be assigned.
Assign same person to conflicting times.
Conflict is blocked or clearly warned according to rule; no double booking is hidden.
Enter normal/overtime hours and invalid negative/excessive values.
Valid time persists and service costs/reporting update; invalid values fail.
Correct zone/rate is applied and old transaction snapshots stay unchanged.
Add supplier, quantities, costs, tax, and progress status.
Totals and status are correct and records are traceable to supplier/inventory.
Trigger rule, refresh, acknowledge, then trigger resolution.
Alert is created once, links to source, records acknowledgement, and resolves correctly.
Record asset telematics/meter and lifecycle event.
Valid event updates history/alerts; invalid values do not corrupt the current asset state.
Generate overview, dispatch, task, quote, approval, case, personnel, alert, parts, PO, and transfer reports.
Open each report, filter/search/page/export, and compare source data.
Professional reports contain matching scoped records and all matching export rows.
Open finance register with scope filters.
Filter invoices, payments, bonds, customers, status, and dates.
Counts and records match permitted bookings; aging and balances are accurate.
Generate invoice from completed/eligible rental charges.
Compare agreement, return charges, tax, payments, and invoice.
Number, customer, lines, tax, total, and balance match the source snapshot.
Edit lines on an eligible unpaid invoice.
Add taxable/non-taxable lines and invalid quantity/rate; save.
